theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos
  rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos, ← Fintype.card_set]
  refine (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq
    (fun _ hA _ hB h => hPP _ hA _ hB h.eq_bot)).mp ?_
  intro Q hQ hPQ
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
  simp only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Finset.mem_coe] at hQ
  grind only [Finset.subset_iff]
